title: Import graph
replaceNotice: Importing replaces the current drawing and clears the undo history.

verdict.ready: Ready to simulate: the input turns {{rangeDeg}}°.
verdict.range: Moves, but only {{rangeDeg}}° of input range.

report.unparseable: The text is not valid JSON.
report.unknown-format: This is not a recognized graph format.
report.too-large: The graph is too large to import ({{what}}: {{actual}}, limit {{limit}}).
report.empty-graph: The graph has no nodes or no edges.
report.no-ground: No node is marked as the fixed (ground) link.
report.self-loop: An edge joins a node to itself and was dropped.
report.duplicate-edge: A repeated edge was dropped (the graph must stay simple).
report.disconnected: {{nodes}} node(s) are not connected to the ground ({{components}} separate group(s)).
report.partial-positions: Only some nodes have positions, so the drawing cannot use them as given.
report.missing-input: No input (motor) edge is marked. Choose which joint to drive.
report.several-inputs: {{count}} edges are marked as input. Choose one.
report.input-not-on-ground: The input edge is not attached to the ground.
report.prismatic-no-axis: A slider joint has no axis.
report.multi-joint: {{links}} links meet at one joint; it will be imported as a star.
report.units-unknown: Length units "{{units}}" are not recognized; they are kept as a label only.
report.layout-applied: Positions were computed automatically ({{tries}} tries, {{rangeDeg}}° of motion).
report.layout-unavailable: Automatic layout is not available here.
report.lengths-infeasible: No drawing matches the given link lengths (residual {{residual}}).
report.not-one-dof-topology: This graph does not have one degree of freedom (Grübler F = {{gruebler}}).
report.not-drivable: The mechanism cannot be driven from the chosen input.
report.assembly-failed: The mechanism does not assemble with these positions.

fix.centroid: Place missing nodes at the centroid
